title: v1.3.0 — Multiple Routine Templates & Day-Based Weekly Planner
changelog: Multiple Routine Templates: Create, customize, duplicate, and manage distinct day templates (e.g., Weekday, Weekend, Holiday, Deep Focus)
Day-Based Weekly Routine Planner: Visual Monday–Sunday matrix assigning dedicated routine templates to specific days of the week
Quick-Copy Shortcuts: One-click 'Copy Monday to Weekdays' and 'Copy Saturday to Sunday' actions for effortless planner scheduling
4-Tier Precedence Engine: Deterministic resolution ordering Date Occurrence Override > Date Template Override > Weekly Day Assignment > Default Routine
Today Timeline Template Switching: Active template badge on the daily routine view with one-click quick switch dropdown
Single-Template File I/O: Export templates to shareable JSON files and import via drag-and-drop or file upload with Zod validation and collision safeguards
Cloud Sync & Backup Upgrade: Backup package v1.1 with full backward-compatibility for legacy v1.0 archives and seamless Firestore sync
72-Hour Notification Alignment: Background notifications automatically recalculate rolling reminder windows according to active day templates
